description.blurb: Gerd (formerly S/2004 S25 and Saturn LVII) is a natural satellite of Saturn discovered in 2004 and announced in 2019.
description.more: In mythology, Gerd is a Norse giantess and a consort of Freyr. She is the personification of fertile soil. Gerd is about 4 kilometres in diameter, and orbits Saturn in 1150.69 days, at an inclination of 173° to the ecliptic.
